_help: How the College & Career Finder ranks CEI trainings and careers. Every recommendation is a real CEI training (one per career profile, at /training/<slug>/, plus the checkout courses). weights: points a training earns for each connection to the visitor's answers (career: a career they chose; major, minor, interestCareer: the training is in that item's career list; interestField: it is in a career field linked to one of their interests; industry: it is in an industry they picked in step 7; relatedCareer: related to a career they chose; skillCourse: listed under a skill they picked, counted in full only when it shares a career field with the rest of their answers; skillMatch and skillAll: small extras for trainings already related). A training must reach minScore to be recommended, so unrelated courses are never shown just to fill space. Earlier items in a major's or interest's career list count more (each later position keeps 'positionDecay' less, down to 'positionFloor'). boosts: extra points for a training (career slug -> points, negative to demote). hide: careers whose training is never recommended. pins: majors -> trainings always listed first for that major (they still must be related). courseOverrides: career slug -> { name, description, url, enrollUrl } to change how a training is shown in the finder.
